$comment: Per-route title and description. JSON rather than TS because two consumers need it: the pages at runtime (useDocumentMeta) and scripts/prerender-routes.mjs, which stamps it into the built HTML so crawlers and social scrapers see it without running JavaScript. Node cannot import a TS module, and parsing one is fragile — so this is the one shared source.
